contexts.text: It has been given to speak... with many who had been known to me. AC 448. AC 1886, Preface. AC 5006:4. AC 10758:end.
From good they knew truth...
When it was given to know that (they spoke) from themselves, I at once knew that it was false.
They know no more than the brutes what the Spiritual and Celestial are.
To call by name = to know the quality.
He who knows many truths and goods...
As they had what is fundamental in themselves... they could not but know all things which are thence.
They knew no other doctrinals than external rites.
In Heaven they know not names...
Then he no longer knows what is of the body.
Those who had been in any way known in the life of the body... are present in a moment.
Those who know (can profane).
A good Spirit is known (from his influx, and also from every one of his words). (Also an evil Spirit.) (Compare with AC 1389.)
Men also can sometimes know what another is (really) thinking...
Few, if any, know...
Man is introduced to wisdom or life by knowing and knowing, or by scientifics and cognitions.
The Angels know and acknowledge that they know nothing from themselves, but that whatever they know is from the Lord...
He who does not acknowledge that there are infinite things which he does not know, beyond those which he knows, cannot be in the holiness of ignorance in which are the Angels...
Why Jehovah asks man what He already knows.
Because I have known him () = that it is true. Explained.
It is known that...
The Lord alone knows...
Evident from those I have known in the bodily life.
They who are in the affection of good, know and perceive from the good itself in which they are that it is so.
To know, when predicated of the Divine... = to be united; or, what is the same, to be glorified.
Thus man does not know from himself anything which is of eternal life.
He believes himself to be good when he knows many things...
He who knows not the state of man, may believe that conjunction is possible with truths... when he knows them...
One whom I had known... AC 5058. AC 5720:end. AC 5991:2.
Does not know what the internal man is...
The things which man knows are comparatively scarcely anything in comparison with the things which he does not know.
This man also knows and observes, although not instructed by any knowledge.
In the other life, there are manifested not only the things which a man knows about himself, but also the things which he does not know.

I know you not = rejection. Not to know them, in the internal sense, is not to be in any charity towards the neighbour, and, through this, in conjunction with the Lord. They who are not in conjunction, are said not to be known.
It cannot be said of God that he takes Knowledge, for He knows all things from Himself.
The Spirits... thence knew all things which I had ever known about that matter.
When I thought of a man who was known to me...

Who knew not Joseph () = which was completely alienated from the Internal. Not to know = to be alienated; for he who does not know truth, and does not want to know it, is alienated from the truth of the Church.
There is such a communication among Spirits, that when they are in a Society, if they are accepted and loved, all things which they know are communicated, not by speech, but by influx.
If the Knowledges with them were to be increased to eternity, they could not arrive at an acquaintance with generals.
I have known their griefs () = foresight as to how much they have been immersed in falsities. To know, when said of the Lord, = foresight... because the Lord knows each and all things from eternity.
And I know () = foresight.
Those become merely sensuous and corporeal men who have first known the things which are of the Spiritual World, and afterwards have rejected them...
I know not Jehovah () = that they do not care for the Lord. Not to know = not to care; for he who does not care, says that he does not know.
In My name Jehovah I was not known to them () = that in a state of temptations they did not think of the Divine things of the Church.
To make known = to teach.
I know this from the living experience of so many years.
To know, when said of Jehovah, = to know and foresee from eternity.
Make known to me, I pray, Thy way, and I shall Know Thee () = instruction concerning the Divine as to its quality with them... To make known = instruction.
To be made known, when said of the Divine with them, = to be revealed.
Not to know = not to perceive.
By which (spheres) they are known sometimes at a great distance...
I have seen some of them as if they had been known from infancy, but others as if they were not known at all. (The former) were those who were in a state like that of my spirit...
Not to know, when said by the Lord, = not to be in His love.
Man knows that there is love, but he does not know what love is...
Therefore from a mere action made by the hands, there is known by the Angels... the (Quality of the man)...
Although the universal Christian world knows...
Thus the Angels know the whole man...
At this day this is known, and still it is unknown.
Without acquaintance with correspondences.
That in the other life they meet those known to them. SE 2771. SE 2909.
I have spoken to more than thirty whom I had known in the life of the body...
I knew no otherwise than that I had known that thing, when yet I had known nothing about it...
He who is in any cupidity... (there) knows all things which are of that insane love...
On my acquaintances.

When I have conversed with angelic Spirits, I have observed that they appear to me as if they were acquaintances and friends of long standing, with whom there is a similitude of mind... although I have never seen them before.
Spirits acknowledge as a friend one who is like themselves; as an acquaintance, everyone who receives their ideas...
I know you not = that the Lord is not conjoined with them... for the Lord has His abode with those who are in love and the derivative faith; and these He knows, because He Himself is there.
Lord, Thou knowest () = that the Lord alone has known this.
